description:
AirPods desktop user experience enhancement program


This is a Beta version. If you encounter any questions or bugs while using it, please feel free to open an issue to let us know.
Important
The Windows installers in this release are not Authenticode-signed. Windows may show an unknown publisher or Microsoft Defender SmartScreen warning. Only download files from this official release page.
📜 Change log
1. Added AirPods 5 support, including device recognition, the correct model name, left, right, and charging-case battery status, charging state, and popup animation.
2. Fixed the AirPods Pro charging case being clipped on the right side of the popup animation and fallback image. (Issue #235)
Liking the AirPods 5 so far❤️ Coming from the AirPods 4 ANC, the difference is pretty noticeable!
繁體中文
這是 Beta 測試版本。如果使用時遇到任何問題或錯誤，歡迎 提出 Issue 告訴我們。
Important
此版本的 Windows 安裝程式未使用 Authenticode 程式碼簽章，因此 Windows 可能顯示「未知的發行者」或 Microsoft Defender SmartScreen 警告。請只從此官方 Release 頁面下載。
📜 更新內容
1. 新增 AirPods 5 支援，包含裝置辨識、正確的型號名稱、左耳、右耳與充電盒電量、充電狀態及彈窗動畫。
2. 修正 AirPods Pro 充電盒在彈窗動畫與備用圖片右側遭到裁切的問題。 (Issue #235)
我愛AirPods 5❤️ 從AirPods 4 ANC升級上來也很有感！
